## Rules

- Your friend must be new to Tallowbrook.
- You can't refer yourself or open a second account.
- Referral bonuses may be reported to tax authorities.

## Didn't get your bonus?

Check your friend used your link and received the direct deposits in time. If they did, message support.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.

[referrals] Refer a friend (effective 2025-01-01)
When a friend opens a Tallowbrook account with your invite link and qualifies, you each get $25.00.

## How your friend qualifies

They need to receive at least $500 in direct deposits within 60 days of opening their account.

## When you're paid

Both bonuses are paid within 5 business days of your friend qualifying.

## Your invite link

Tap Profile, then Invite friends. Share the link any way you like. Your friend has to use the link when they sign up. We can't add a referral afterward.

## What it costs

Nothing. Cushion has no fees ($0.00) and no interest.

## Paying it back

Your next deposit repays it automatically. If your balance stays negative for 30 days, Cushion is suspended. See "Repaying Cushion".

## Turning it off

You can switch Cushion off at any time in the same place. Purchases larger than your balance are then declined, with no fee.

[support-third-parties] Can someone else manage my account? (effective 2025-01-01)
Tallowbrook accounts belong to one person. We don't offer joint accounts or authorized users, and support only acts for the account holder in their own signed-in session.

## What that means

- We can't discuss an account with a spouse, partner, parent, child or friend, even if they know the account details.
- We can't make changes because someone else asks, even if they're messaging from the account holder's phone.

[transfers-brookpay] Sending money with BrookPay (effective 2025-01-01)
BrookPay lets you send money to another Tallowbrook member by phone number, email or username. It's free, it works every day, and the money arrives in seconds.

## Send money

Tap Transfers, then BrookPay. Choose the person, enter the amount and confirm. The recipient sees the money straight away.

[savings-round-ups] Round-ups (effective 2025-01-01)
Round-ups save your spare change. Each time you pay with your card, we round the purchase up to the next dollar and move the difference into a Savings Pocket you choose.

## Turn on round-ups

Tap Savings, choose a pocket, and switch on Round-ups.

## How it works

- Round-ups are added up during the day and moved once a day.
- Purchases that are already a whole dollar amount aren't rounded.
- Round-ups only apply to card purchases, not to ATM withdrawals, transfers or fees.
- If your main balance is too low, that day's round-up is

[savings-pockets] How Savings Pockets work (effective 2026-06-01)
earn the APY for your plan: 0.50% on Basic, 2.00% on Plus and 3.75% on Premium. Rates are variable.

## Spending from a pocket

Your card spends from your main balance, not from pockets. Move money back first.

## Closing a pocket

Tap the pocket, then Close. Any money and accrued interest move to your main balance.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.
